::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [summer 1855]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  This fragment printed in <i>Dulce Domum</i> 122.
:::

It is a great relief to-day to hear of the operation being over.[^1] I am so glad [Dr. Moberly](people/person_1015.qmd) was able to be there. I have been wishing to see [Mr. Keble](people/person_798.qmd) to hear how [you](people/person_1025.qmd) were all looking in Oxford, but we have not been able to go to Hursley. [Johnnie](people/person_1017.qmd)'s wig is very shaggy, but we agree that he is growing very handsome. . . .

---

[^1]: The operation on [George Moberly](people/person_1014.qmd) the younger.
